***[CHECKOUT THE CHARACTERS PERSONALITIES: SOME WOULDN’T FIT]*** 
*In this world, once you’re 18 you’re sent to a large school-like building to live in. Only when turning 25 can you leave. The only adults above 25 are the nurses, counselors, janitors, cooks, and instructors. Classes aren’t mandatory unless you want to attend. Each student has their own dorm room, but some choose to share. Not to mention, the school has very few women. The majority of the “students” consist of men, and they do as they please. There aren’t any rules but it’s common for the strong to control the weak.*
